primary_profile.interpretation: Equal maximum encoded-width allowance and equal semantic group counts; actual transmitted encoded widths differ from 42 to 77 and must be reported on every row. This is not equal actual encoded capacity.

capacity_geometry.exact_numeric_categorical_width_signatur: For fixed numeric and categorical group counts, categorical subset sums are unique across all five categorical atom widths 17,8,7,6,41. With four retained numeric atoms, an exact encoded width fixes the entire mask.
capacity_geometry.same_deleted_group_union: Eight semantic atoms; union encoded width equals that mask's individual width.
capacity_geometry.different_deleted_group_union: The exact original 83-column raw input, independent of deletion order. All 20 such pairs are raw-information equivalent under fixed public state, even if their serialized complete views or fitted heads differ.
capacity_geometry.attribution_limit: An exact encoded-width union match for a same-deletion pair fixes the deleted categorical identity, so a distinct nonalias exact-width matched control may not exist. Retain true aliases as ties and label missing dependent attribution comparisons incomplete.

prefit_conditions: M1 binds the exact 83-column ordered source schema, the nine complete atoms and allowed role-file hashes in the new effective lock.
M0 freezes the five masks, 25 pair assignments, this cap interpretation and any fallback trigger before new fits or INNER_SELECTION outcomes.
M2 and M3 use the same proposal bank, fitting-role folds, heads, calibration and bounded search; exact release aliases remain in the control pool as ties.
M4 independently records canonical raw-union identity, exact view transport eligibility, attack-fit tuning roles and the complete fixed inference family before Adult scoring.
M5 rechecks the committed effective lock, queue admission and source hashes before issuing a final real-fit preaccess PASS.
